rules: BLOCKED P02 coverage => INVALID and no analysis.
Known private/paid/provider gaps cap completeness at MEDIUM in the free/public configuration.
Unresolved material root families reduce completeness; they are not neutralized.
Negative price transmission never changes causal pressure; it raises missing-driver risk and can reduce completeness.
HIGH requires non-blocked coverage, no material known observability cap, and broad root semantic resolution.
Thresholds used to categorize coverage are governance thresholds, not probabilities or market scores.
